t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keeping picking the same gnome until its multiplier starts to go down then change gnome

vb_textbox.text: You have to pick the gnome with the highest multiplier until the multiplier goes down then switch to the other gnome on the opposite side with the lower mulitplier, continue to do this throughout the game. For example if the multiplier starts at 5 on the left side (s key on keyboard) then changes to a 1 multiplier then switch to the right hand side ( k key on the keyboard).
